cta: Follow for your daily 60 seconds of AI news.
hook: One warehouse fleet just crossed one million robot picks in a single day.
key_points: The milestone was reached with a fleet of 500 mobile robots.
Pick accuracy is reported at 99.2 percent across all shifts.
The robots use vision models to handle mixed, unsorted inventory.
Operators say the hardest items are still soft, deformable goods.
title: Warehouse Robots Hit 1M Picks a Day (Example Topic)
